rows: Read the machine status. Confirm the content and machine are enabled by the server.
Remove redstone or turn off Pause unless this particular program needs a signal. The Weather Controller is an important exception: it needs a signal to act.
Check the exact recipe family, ingredient counts, circuit variant and analysis/stability requirement. A full FE bar cannot make an unmatched recipe run.
Confirm research for the machine owner, not merely a different nearby player.
Make room in every output and pending-result destination. Do not install a Void Upgrade simply to conceal blocked storage.
Compare stored FE with the full required batch cost, including overrides. Available cable throughput is not the same as enough stored energy.
For a world machine, inspect structure, owner, loaded chunks and denied-action status.
If the problem persists, keep the relevant game log and the machine/configuration details. Do not change several ratios and recipes simultaneously.
